arrays-hashing.spot: Need to know "have I seen this before?", count things, or group things that look alike.
arrays-hashing.tool: unordered_map / unordered_set: trade O(n) space for O(1) lookups.

two-pointers.spot: Sorted array, pairs/triplets that hit a target, or comparing from both ends.
two-pointers.tool: left and right move toward each other; move the side that can improve the answer.

sliding-window.spot: Longest / shortest / best contiguous subarray or substring with a condition.
sliding-window.tool: Grow right every step, shrink left while the window is invalid, record the best.

stack.spot: Matching pairs, undo/nesting, or "next greater / smaller element".
stack.tool: Push while it's unresolved, pop when the current item resolves it (monotonic stack).

binary-search.spot: Sorted data, or the answer is a number you can test with "is X enough?" (yes/no flips once).
binary-search.tool: lo/hi over the answer space; check mid; throw away half each step.

linked-list.spot: Reorder or merge nodes, find the middle, detect a cycle, or an array secretly acting like a list (i → nums[i]).
linked-list.tool: Dummy head, slow/fast pointers, reverse in place with prev/cur/next.

trees.spot: Anything on a binary tree: depth, paths, validation, level by level.
trees.tool: DFS recursion (what does each child return?) or BFS with a queue for levels.

tries.spot: Many words, prefix lookups, autocomplete, word search over a dictionary.
tries.tool: Node with children[26] and an isEnd flag; walk letter by letter.

heap.spot: k-th largest / smallest, top-k, most frequent, or always need the current min/max.
heap.tool: priority_queue; keep a heap of size k, or two heaps for the median.

backtracking.spot: Generate all subsets / permutations / combinations, or place things with rules.
backtracking.tool: choose → recurse → un-choose; prune early when a choice can't work.

graphs.spot: Grid or network: islands, reachability, dependencies, shortest steps.
graphs.tool: BFS for shortest steps, DFS for flood fill, topo sort for ordering, union-find for components.

advanced-graphs.spot: Weighted shortest path, minimum spanning tree, or ordering from rules.
advanced-graphs.tool: Dijkstra (heap), Prim/Kruskal, Bellman-Ford for k stops, topo sort.

dp-1d.spot: Count the ways / min cost / max value, and the answer at i depends on a few earlier answers.
dp-1d.tool: Define dp[i], write the recurrence, set base cases, fill left to right.

dp-2d.spot: Two strings, a grid, or (index, capacity) both matter.
dp-2d.tool: dp[i][j] table; each cell from top / left / diagonal.

greedy.spot: A locally best choice is provably safe (max subarray, jumps, scheduling).
greedy.tool: Make the best choice now and never look back; prove it with an exchange argument.

intervals.spot: Ranges [start, end] that overlap, merge, or need rooms.
intervals.tool: Sort by start (or end), then sweep and compare with the last kept interval.

math-geometry.spot: Matrix rotation/spiral, digits, powers, or coordinate tricks.
math-geometry.tool: Work layer by layer, or with index math; watch overflow.

bit-manipulation.spot: Single / missing number, count bits, add without +.
bit-manipulation.tool: XOR cancels pairs, n & (n-1) drops the lowest set bit, shifts move bits.
